_comment: Where to look. bootstrap-sources.js rewrites this file wholesale; what you WANT lives in preferences.json, which it never touches.
_watchlistNote: Every board below was probed live on 2026-09-02 and returned postings. Slug boards (greenhouse/lever/ashby/workable/recruitee/bamboohr) take one identifier. Workday takes three — tenant, host, site — because a Workday board is addressed by cell and career-site name, not by a single slug. Run `node scripts/probe-workday.js <company>` to find the three parts for a company not listed here.
_tier1SearchKeywords: Workday boards are searched, not listed: BMO's board is 927 postings and searchText narrows it to 54 server-side. Every term here costs one paginated round-trip per Workday board, so overlapping terms are expensive for nothing - 'developer' was dropped because 'software developer' covers the case that matters, and 'graduate' because 'new grad' does. Omit this key to fall back to preferences.roleKeywords.

tier1Watchlist.name: Neo Financial
tier1Watchlist._note: Calgary HQ. 94 postings, 14 in Alberta at time of probe.

tier1Watchlist.name: Jobber
tier1Watchlist._note: Edmonton HQ, hires remote across Canada.

tier1Watchlist.name: StackAdapt
tier1Watchlist._note: Remote-Canada roles list Calgary explicitly. The only source that has ever produced a Calgary posting for you.

tier1Watchlist.name: BMO
tier1Watchlist._note: 927 postings. Had 'Full Stack Engineer (AI-Enabled), Calgary AB' open at time of probe.

tier1Watchlist.name: SpaceX
tier1Watchlist._note: Kept on purpose. Seattle is a deliberate 5% lottery-ticket bucket for big-name roles worth relocating a year for; SpaceX is one of the few of those with a public board. You hold no US work authorization, so a posting here that never mentions sponsorship has its score cut to 35% and is flagged 🛂 on the row — visible, but not competing with the 95% you would actually take.

_tier2Sources: The Tier 2 sources to actually run. Removing one from this list stops it being fetched at all — it is not merely a table of rate limits.
_weworkremotelyRemoved: WeWorkRemotely was removed on 2026-09-02: it charges the applicant to apply, so its postings cost money to act on. The connector still exists and works; re-add { "name": "weworkremotely", "rateLimitMs": 2000 } here to turn it back on, along with tier2WwrCategories.
_tier2KeywordNote: Jan 2027 is deliberately absent. Job boards index titles and descriptions, not start dates, so searching the API for "Jan 2027" returns almost nothing. It is handled as a scoring signal instead - see timingKeywords in preferences.json - which boosts a posting that does mention the window without hiding the ones that do not.
